risks.chain_specific_risk: Dependent on the ongoing operational reliability and performance stability of connected blockchain networks and public RPC nodes.
risks.ux_risk: Physical damage or security compromises of on-device storage modules can result in the permanent loss of the agent's private execution keys.

notes: Removes human approval bottlenecks from digital asset trading, establishing a true developer foundation for independent machine economy architectures.
